UnitBalance (attributes, mana, regen, def, spd, sight, collision), UnitWeapons (range, cool1 period, damage), UnitData (turnRate).
Units: attributes/gains are the base and per-level values; mana/regen are per s (hundredths for regen); armor, bat and damage in hundredths.
spd is reference units per second; sight, collision and range are reference units. Canonical row per hero name: most common stat tuple, then non-TX id.
